column1: # Library code in the engine's range with no C++ here, on purpose (as sce/not_ported.tsv): Sony's MPEG
# stream sample (audiodec, readbuf, strfile, vibuf, videodec, vobuf), compiled into the engine's ps2Movie.c.
# No source of it is on disk and it is in no Xbox or GameCube build. What Z-Axis changed in it (zfile, the
# texture, its decoder words, the IOP lock) is the engine's and is in zge/movie/ps2. Columns: address, library,
# name, in the other games (DM2 PS2, BMX XXX PS2: identical, close or none), why.
